reference_sql:
SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', valid_from) AS DATE) AS change_month,
       COUNT(*) AS price_changes
FROM price_history
WHERE valid_from BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY date_trunc('month', valid_from)
alternatives: SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', valid_from) AS DATE) AS change_month, COUNT(*) AS price_changes FROM price_history WHERE year(valid_from) = 2025 GROUP BY 1

SELECT make_date(2025, month(valid_from), 1) AS change_month, COUNT(*) AS price_changes FROM price_history WHERE valid_from >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND valid_from < DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY month(valid_from)

other_way.sql: SELECT make_date(2025, month(valid_from), 1) AS change_month, COUNT(*) AS price_changes FROM price_history WHERE valid_from >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND valid_from < DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY month(valid_from)
other_way.tradeoff: Building each date from 2025 and the month number works here, but only because the filter keeps a single year.

solver.query:
SELECT date_trunc('month', valid_from)::DATE AS change_month, COUNT(*) AS price_changes
FROM price_history
WHERE valid_from >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND valid_from <= DATE '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY 1
